target.purpose: Closed modern interannual skill and water-mode evidence layer for the 1337 mechanistic capacity model.
target.population_target_policy: Modern yield observations and crop-model simulations are validation-only. They cannot become 1337 population targets or replace the historical aggregate anchor registry.

acceptance_rule: The exact 101-year 1337 crop-risk gate remains blocked until a source-backed annual yield layer or an exact-location, same-geography physical simulation is available for every required crop and sampled footprint. Modern global layers may validate relative skill only.

prior_evidence_registry.role: Retained historical and hydroclimate evidence; this wave adds a separate modern global skill layer and does not delete or reinterpret those records.

sources.title: Global dataset of historical yields v1.2 and v1.3 aligned version
evidence: The public archive supplies annual 0.5-degree crop-yield estimates for 1981-2016.
Location and super-region summaries are area-weighted from deterministic nearest-grid crosswalks; missing crop cells remain missing.
This is a modern observation-aligned product with 2000 harvested-area semantics, not a 1337 low-input or historical cropland observation.
allowed_uses: Validate relative annual yield anomaly timing and uncertainty tails by super-region.
Provide an independent modern observation layer for ablations against crop-model risk.
disallowed_uses: irrigation acreage or historical crop-share inference

sources.title: ISIMIP2a CLM-Crop WATCH WFDEI historical rice simulations
sources.citation: Müller et al. (2023), ISIMIP2a Simulation Data from the Agriculture Sector.
evidence: The archive supplies paired no-irrigation and full-irrigation annual rice simulations on the same 0.5-degree grid.
Paired differences are computed only for finite same-cell/year values and are kept separate from GDHY observations.
The simulations are modern climate/model outputs and do not represent observed 1337 technology, cropland, or irrigation area.
allowed_uses: Validate rain-fed versus full-irrigation response direction and relative interannual risk.
Widen uncertainty where the crop-model and modern observation anomaly layers disagree.

regional_coverage.ocean_group: atlantic_ocean_continent is retained as an explicit zero-coverage diagnostic and is never filled.
regional_coverage.mapping_policy: Nearest-grid mapping is deterministic and area-weighted for summaries; it does not manufacture crop observations where the source has no valid cell.

validation_design.grouping: rice × rain-fed/full-irrigation × six EU5 super-region groups
validation_design.correlation_input: paired finite area-weighted annual anomalies over 1981-2012
validation_design.interpretation: Relative modern skill and uncertainty only; no 1337 target is created.

blocking_gaps: No public machine-readable global annual absolute-yield observations cover 1100-1500 with mapped historical boundaries.
GDHY is modern and sparse in crop-estimated cells; its harvested-area definition is not a 1337 land-use definition.
ISIMIP is a modern crop-model simulation and is not an observed historical yield or irrigation-area label.
Exact 101-year 1337-compatible crop-risk simulation remains unresolved for every required crop and location footprint.
The wave closes relative modern validation, not absolute 1337 yield parameter calibration.

acceptance.reason: GDHY and ISIMIP provide reproducible global relative skill and water-mode diagnostics. They are deliberately validation-only; the direct 1337 annual-yield gate remains blocked until same-geography source-backed simulations or historical observations cover all required labels.
